about: SpellDirector sound cue library. A template's sound_cue layer names one of these cues; the viewer plays it in sync with the layer's beats. Every cue has a procedural Web Audio placeholder (web/js/audio.js, recipe = the cue id). To use real recordings, list files under 'samples' (paths relative to web/sounds/) and credit each one in web/sounds/CREDITS.md. 'sfx_prompt' is a ready text prompt for a text-to-SFX service. See web/sounds/README.md.

charge.label: Energy charge
charge.describes: A rising swell of energy that builds in pitch and volume, then cuts off.
charge.sfx_prompt: magical energy charging up, rising pitch swell, building tension, cuts off cleanly

hum.label: Low hum
hum.describes: A steady, low, smooth hum, like a powered beam or a held aura.
hum.sfx_prompt: steady low energy hum, smooth sci-fi drone, seamless loop

buzz.label: Electric buzz
buzz.describes: A harsh, gritty electrical buzz, like a live wire or a transformer.
buzz.sfx_prompt: harsh electrical buzz, live wire arcing, gritty transformer hum, loop

crackle.label: Electric crackle
crackle.describes: Random small electric pops and snaps, like static discharge.
crackle.sfx_prompt: random electric static crackle, small sharp snaps and pops, sparse

sizzle.label: Sizzle
sizzle.describes: A bright fluttering hiss, like current running through the air or meat on a grill.
sizzle.sfx_prompt: bright electric sizzle, fluttering high hiss, crackling energy

zap.label: Zap
zap.describes: A short electric zap that sweeps down in pitch.
zap.sfx_prompt: short electric zap, quick downward pitch sweep, sharp spark

crack.label: Sharp crack
crack.describes: A sharp, bright snap with a short ring-out, like a thunder crack or a whip.
crack.sfx_prompt: sharp lightning thunder crack, bright snap, short ring-out, close

boom.label: Deep boom
boom.describes: A deep, heavy boom that drops in pitch, like an explosion or a big hit.
boom.sfx_prompt: deep cinematic boom, heavy low-end explosion impact, short tail

rumble.label: Low rumble
rumble.describes: A low rolling rumble that wobbles, like distant thunder or a quake.
rumble.sfx_prompt: low rolling thunder rumble, distant, slowly fading

impact.label: Thud
impact.describes: A short, punchy body hit or thud with a click on top.
impact.sfx_prompt: short punchy impact thud, solid hit, tight

crash.label: Crash
crash.describes: A noisy crash with debris scattering after it, like rocks or a wall breaking.
crash.sfx_prompt: heavy crash with scattering debris and rubble, rocks breaking

shatter.label: Shatter
shatter.describes: Bright glassy pings and tinkles, like glass or ice breaking.
shatter.sfx_prompt: glass or ice shattering, bright tinkling shards falling

ignite.label: Ignite
ignite.describes: A soft fwoomp as something bursts into flame.
ignite.sfx_prompt: fire ignition whoosh, soft fwoomp as flames burst up

fire.label: Burning fire
fire.describes: A roaring, crackling fire, like a torch or a burning area.
fire.sfx_prompt: roaring fire with crackling embers, steady burning flames, loop

whoosh.label: Whoosh
whoosh.describes: Air rushing past, like a fast swing or a projectile flying by.
whoosh.sfx_prompt: fast air whoosh, swoosh passing by, clean

wind.label: Wind
wind.describes: A breathy gust of wind that rises and falls.
wind.sfx_prompt: howling wind gust rising and falling, airy

shimmer.label: Shimmer
shimmer.describes: Twinkling high chimes, like sparkles, healing or a magic glow.
shimmer.sfx_prompt: magical shimmer, twinkling bell chimes and sparkles, soft
